summary.en: An Act to make provision concerning statutory declarations

source.name: Attorney General's Chambers, Brunei Darussalam (AGC) — LAWS OF BRUNEI / Government Gazette

completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《CAP-12-2016-ED-STATUTORY-DECLARATIONS-ACT.pdf》（5 页），本次切分 4 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: This Act may be cited as the Statutory Declarations Act.

It shall be lawful for any Magistrate or any officer authorised by His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan to take and receive in Brunei Darussalam the declaration of any person voluntarily making the declaration in the form set out in the Schedule.

heading.en: False declarations punishable under Penal Code

text.en: Declarations made in Brunei Darussalam by virtue of   the   provisions of this Act shall be deemed to be such declarations as are referred to in sections 199 and 200 of the Penal Code (Chapter 22). Fees

A person making any declaration by virtue of the provisions of this Act shall pay to the officer taking the declaration such fees as His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan in Council may, by public notification, prescribe.

STATUTORY DECLARATION I, A.B, do solemnly and sincerely declare that , and I make this solemn declaration conscientiously believing the same to be true, and by virtue of the provisions of the Statutory Declarations Act (Chapter 12). Subscribed and solemnly declared by the above named in Brunei Darussalam this day of 20 , (Signature of Declarant)
